children: Iron ore is higher in early Asian trading. The commodity's supply and demand dynamics have improved, Nanhua Futures analysts say in a note. Investors expect demand to recover due to seasonal factors, they say. The most-traded iron-ore contract on the Dalian Commodity Exchange is 0.7% higher at 726.50 yuan a ton.(tracy.qu@wsj.com)
